description:
About Bobyard

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

 

Who we are

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.

 

Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.

 

Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.

 

Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

 

About the role

You'll own features across React, Django, and PostgreSQL, from product design through production. No layers of process, no ticket queues. Just clear problems, strong teammates, and contractors who depend on what you ship.

 

What you'll do

• Build and ship features across React, Django, and PostgreSQL

• Design APIs, data models, and infrastructure that hold up under load

• Own frontend performance and UX on interfaces users live in all day

• Partner with product, CV, and design to scope and launch features

• Deploy, monitor, and debug production on AWS and GCP

• Prototype fast, iterate with users, and invest where it works

 

What we're looking for

• Strong fullstack fundamentals: system design, performance, architecture

• Production experience with React and a Python backend (Django preferred)

• You've shipped and run features in production, frontend through infra

• Product judgment. You know why we're building it and advocate for the user

• You create clarity in ambiguous problems and deliver

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and specialized experience

 

Nice to have

• Experience with canvas-heavy or data-dense interfaces

• Prior early-stage startup experience

• Exposure to construction or other real-world industries

 

A note on pace

We move fast, and priorities shift as we learn from customers. Playbooks, context, and requirements are often incomplete when work starts, and you'll be expected to shape them. If that pace excites you, you'll fit in well.

 

What we offer

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

• $140,000–$165,000 base (depending on level) + bonus + 0.02%–0.05% equity

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%

• Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute

• Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!
